Qwen38VLLoader.description: Choose a main model and vision projector, then connect to local chat. Weights load when chat starts.

model_file.name: model file (GGUF)
model_file.tooltip: Main Qwen3.8 GGUF model file. Q4_K_M is a practical starting point for 32 GB VRAM.

mmproj_file.name: projector file (mmproj)
mmproj_file.tooltip: Vision projector GGUF required to understand images and video frames.

batch_size.name: batch size
batch_size.tooltip: Number of prompt tokens processed in one llama.cpp batch. Higher can improve prompt processing speed but uses more VRAM.

micro_batch_size.name: micro batch size
micro_batch_size.tooltip: Maximum tokens processed in one physical llama.cpp sub-batch. Reduce this first if prompt processing runs out of VRAM.

gpu_layers.name: GPU layers
gpu_layers.tooltip: Number of transformer layers offloaded to the GPU. -1 offloads all layers; lower it for partial GPU offload.

free_comfy_vram.name: free ComfyUI VRAM
free_comfy_vram.tooltip: Unload ComfyUI diffusion models before loading this large local vision-language model.

0.name: model configuration
0.tooltip: Prepared model configuration; connect Local Multimodal Chat · Tank. Weights are not loaded yet.

1.name: model info
1.tooltip: Model, projector, source and recommended pair, GPU layers and loading state. Pairing information is based on filenames, not file validation.

VisionAPIEnv.description: Call an API with a key stored in a server environment variable. Images and video are optional.

base_url.name: base URL
base_url.tooltip: OpenAI-compatible API base URL; do not include /chat/completions. The environment-key node only permits the administrator's host allow-list.

model.name: model ID
model.tooltip: Exact model ID exposed by the API provider.

api_key_env.name: API key environment variable
api_key_env.tooltip: Environment variable containing the API key. The request host must be administrator-allow-listed.

system_prompt.name: persona / system prompt
system_prompt.tooltip: Optional persona and system-level instruction; leave blank to use the provider default.

prompt.name: user prompt
prompt.tooltip: User instruction sent to the API, together with any attached image or video input.

max_tokens.name: max output tokens
max_tokens.tooltip: Maximum output token count. 0 omits this parameter and uses the provider default.

temperature.name: temperature
temperature.tooltip: Sampling temperature. 0 omits this parameter and uses the provider default.

seed.name: seed
seed.tooltip: Seed sent for sampling when the provider supports it; providers may ignore it.

thinking_mode.name: reasoning effort
thinking_mode.tooltip: Reasoning control: auto leaves the provider unchanged; off disables reasoning when supported; low, medium, high, xhigh, and max are the five unified effort tiers. A provider may reject or map unsupported tiers.

max_video_frames.name: max video frames
max_video_frames.tooltip: Sample at most this many frames from video or video frames. Every image in the image input is still sent.

video_transport.name: video transport
video_transport.tooltip: frames samples the video; video_url sends native video; auto falls back to frames only when encoding fails. Provider format support is still required.

image.name: image / image batch
image.tooltip: One still image or an IMAGE batch; every item is sent in the same API request.

video_frames.name: video frames
video_frames.tooltip: Decoded video as an IMAGE batch; frames are sampled according to max video frames.

video.name: video
video.tooltip: ComfyUI VIDEO input; use frames for broad support or video_url only when the provider supports native video.

1.name: usage
1.tooltip: Token-usage JSON returned by the provider, when available.

3.name: reasoning
3.tooltip: Reasoning text returned by the provider; empty when unavailable.

4.name: raw response
4.tooltip: Original assistant content or complete tool-call message.

VisionChat.description: Ask a local model about text, images or video. Each run is a separate request with no saved conversation.

backend.name: model configuration
backend.tooltip: Connect Qwen3.8 Model Loader · Tank. API Chat nodes output text directly.

system_prompt.name: persona / system prompt
system_prompt.tooltip: Persona and system-level behavior or response-format instruction.

prompt.name: user prompt
prompt.tooltip: User instruction sent with the attached image or video content.

thinking_mode.name: reasoning effort
thinking_mode.tooltip: Qwen auto keeps thinking off; Bonsai auto uses off for text and low for images/video frames. off explicitly disables thinking. Local high maps to medium and max to xhigh.

context_length.name: context length
context_length.tooltip: Local llama.cpp context window for the prompt, media tokens, and response. API backends ignore it; changing it reloads a loaded local model.

max_tokens.name: max output tokens
max_tokens.tooltip: Maximum number of new text tokens to generate. This is only a limit; generation still stops when the model finishes its answer.

temperature.name: temperature
temperature.tooltip: Sampling randomness. Lower values are steadier; higher values are more varied. With a local model, 0 uses deterministic greedy sampling when supported.

top_p.name: top P
top_p.tooltip: Nucleus-sampling probability threshold. Lower values keep only more likely tokens; 0.95 is a strong general default.

top_k.name: top K
top_k.tooltip: For local llama.cpp, restrict each token choice to the top K candidates. 0 disables top-K filtering; API backends ignore it.

min_p.name: min P
min_p.tooltip: For local llama.cpp, discard tokens whose probability is below this fraction of the best token probability. API backends ignore it.

repeat_penalty.name: repeat penalty
repeat_penalty.tooltip: For local llama.cpp, penalize repeated text. 1.0 disables the penalty; API backends ignore it.

seed.name: seed
seed.tooltip: Random seed for reproducible sampling when all other inputs and backend settings match. API providers may ignore it.

max_video_frames.name: max video frames
max_video_frames.tooltip: Sample at most this many frames from video or video frames. Every image in the image input is still sent.

video_transport.name: video transport
video_transport.tooltip: Compatibility option: local models always sample frames. Saved values are retained.

unload_after.name: unload after
unload_after.tooltip: Release this backend after generation. Enable to recover VRAM; disable for faster repeated chats.

image.name: image / image batch
image.tooltip: One still image or an IMAGE batch of still images.

video_frames.name: video frames
video_frames.tooltip: Decoded video frames as a ComfyUI IMAGE batch; the batch is sampled according to max video frames.

video.name: video
video.tooltip: ComfyUI VIDEO object; local models sample it into frames, while API transport follows video transport.

tools_json.name: tools JSON
tools_json.tooltip: Optional OpenAI function/tool schema as one JSON object or an array.

0.name: response
0.tooltip: Final assistant answer without hidden reasoning tags.

1.name: reasoning
1.tooltip: Reasoning text when the backend exposes it.

2.name: raw response
2.tooltip: Raw assistant content or complete tool-call message.

3.name: stats
3.tooltip: Timing, token, speed, media-count, and backend statistics.

VisionUnload.description: Connect the chat response to after to release the model when generation finishes. You can also enable unload after in the chat node.

after.name: after
after.tooltip: Optional: connect the chat response to release the model after that chat completes.

TankTextSplit.description: Split text into a list. Blank items are dropped; connected nodes run once per item.

delimiter.name: delimiter
delimiter.tooltip: Separator. Use \n for a new line and \t for a tab. Leave empty to output the whole text as one item.

start_index.name: start index
start_index.tooltip: Index of the first item to output, counting from 0.

skip_every.name: skip every
skip_every.tooltip: Items skipped after each output item. 1 outputs every other item.

max_count.name: max count
max_count.tooltip: Maximum number of items to output.

trim.name: trim items
trim.tooltip: Remove spaces and line breaks around each item.

regex.name: regex
regex.tooltip: Treat the delimiter as a regular expression, for example [,，] for both commas.

0.name: items
0.tooltip: Each item runs connected nodes once.

TankH3PromptOptimizer.description: Writes MiniMax H3 prompts in the official H3 prompt-writing format (T2VA / I2VA / FL2VA / L2VA / Ref2VA) with a local model, then checks and repairs the format.

backend.name: model
backend.tooltip: Connect Qwen / Bonsai GGUF Loader · Tank (Bonsai-2 v2 recommended).

request.name: request
request.tooltip: What should happen, in plain Chinese or English. Put spoken lines in “quotes”; they are kept verbatim.

mode.name: mode
mode.tooltip: auto picks the official H3 mode from the connected media.

duration_seconds.name: duration (s)
duration_seconds.tooltip: Target video length; connect the output to the H3 node so both agree.

thinking_mode.name: thinking
thinking_mode.tooltip: medium is the tested default; off is fastest but weaker.

correction.name: auto correction
correction.tooltip: If the draft breaks the official format, ask the model once to fix it (kept only if it improves).

unload_after.name: unload after
unload_after.tooltip: Release the language model afterwards so H3 sampling gets the VRAM.

seed.name: seed
seed.tooltip: Sampling seed of the language model.

first_frame.name: first frame
first_frame.tooltip: First frame (I2VA / FL2VA, or a keyframe in a reference task).

last_frame.name: last frame
last_frame.tooltip: Last frame (L2VA / FL2VA, or a keyframe in a reference task).

reference_image_1.name: reference image 1
reference_image_1.tooltip: Reference picture 1 for Ref2VA; separate inputs keep each picture's own size.

reference_image_2.name: reference image 2
reference_image_2.tooltip: Reference picture 2 for Ref2VA; separate inputs keep each picture's own size.

reference_image_3.name: reference image 3
reference_image_3.tooltip: Reference picture 3 for Ref2VA; separate inputs keep each picture's own size.

reference_image_4.name: reference image 4
reference_image_4.tooltip: Reference picture 4 for Ref2VA; separate inputs keep each picture's own size.

reference_image_5.name: reference image 5
reference_image_5.tooltip: Reference picture 5 for Ref2VA; separate inputs keep each picture's own size.

reference_image_6.name: reference image 6
reference_image_6.tooltip: Reference picture 6 for Ref2VA; separate inputs keep each picture's own size.

reference_images.name: reference batch
reference_images.tooltip: Extra reference pictures as one IMAGE batch (same size), numbered after reference image 1-6.

reference_notes.name: reference notes
reference_notes.tooltip: Optional, one line per reference picture, e.g. 'lead actor' / '1980s courtyard'.

source_video_frames.name: source video frames
source_video_frames.tooltip: Frames of a source video for editing, continuation or motion reference.

source_video_role.name: source video role
source_video_role.tooltip: How the source video is used.

reference_audio_note.name: reference audio note
reference_audio_note.tooltip: If an audio reference is used, describe its role (the model cannot hear it).

context_length.name: context length
context_length.tooltip: The official guide plus pictures need about 16-32K tokens.

0.name: H3 prompt
0.tooltip: Official-format H3 prompt for the H3 conditioning node.

TankPromptTemplate.description: Prompt-engineering template for Prompt Optimizer · Tank.

template.name: template
template.tooltip: Pick by target model and task. H3 templates use the official-format engine with checks.

extra_rules.name: extra rules
extra_rules.tooltip: Optional, one rule per line, appended to the template.

TankPromptOptimizer.description: Optimizes a prompt with a local model following the template; the task is inferred from the connected media; seconds is used only when > 0.

backend.name: backend
backend.tooltip: Connect Qwen / Bonsai GGUF Loader · Tank (Bonsai-2 v2 recommended).

prompt.name: prompt
prompt.tooltip: Connect the prompt input (a multiline text node). Lines in quotes are kept verbatim.

thinking_mode.name: thinking
thinking_mode.tooltip: Default high. If the answer runs out of tokens the node retries with a bigger budget, never with less thinking.

context_length.name: context length
context_length.tooltip: Context window for the local model (pictures + template + answer). Default 32768.

temperature.name: temperature
temperature.tooltip: Randomness. Lower is steadier, higher is more varied. 0.6 is the tested default.

top_p.name: top p
top_p.tooltip: Nucleus sampling share. Usually left alone.

top_k.name: top k
top_k.tooltip: Only the K most likely words are considered; 0 = no limit. Usually left alone.

min_p.name: min p
min_p.tooltip: Drop words below this share of the best word's probability. Usually left alone.

repeat_penalty.name: repeat penalty
repeat_penalty.tooltip: Above 1 discourages repeating words. Usually left alone.

seed.name: seed
seed.tooltip: Language-model seed. Same inputs + same seed = same prompt.

unload_after.name: unload after
unload_after.tooltip: Release the language model afterwards so sampling gets the VRAM.

seconds.name: seconds
seconds.tooltip: Target duration. 0 = not used; connect or type a value above 0 to use it.

first_frame.name: first frame
first_frame.tooltip: First frame alone = image-to-video; with a last frame = first/last-frame video.

reference_image_1.name: reference image 1
reference_image_1.tooltip: Reference picture 1 (kept at its own size). Any reference picture makes this a reference task. H3 takes up to 9.

reference_image_2.name: reference image 2
reference_image_2.tooltip: Reference picture 2 (kept at its own size). Any reference picture makes this a reference task. H3 takes up to 9.

TankOptionalImageDownscale.description: Resizes a picture to about N megapixels (shrink only by default); outputs nothing when no picture is connected, so optional reference inputs downstream are simply skipped.

max_megapixels.name: max megapixels
max_megapixels.tooltip: Target size; larger pictures are shrunk to it. Default 1.2.

image.name: image
image.tooltip: Optional. Empty or bypassed = no output.

upscale_method.name: method
upscale_method.tooltip: lanczos is sharpest (default); area suits big reductions; nearest-exact does not interpolate.

multiple_of.name: multiple of
multiple_of.tooltip: Snap width/height to a multiple of this (e.g. 16, 32); 0 keeps the exact size.

allow_upscale.name: allow upscale
allow_upscale.tooltip: Also enlarge smaller pictures to the target size; default shrink only.
